# @kurto/payload-deploy-trigger

> Payload CMS 3.x plugin for triggering deployments via webhooks (Cloudflare Pages, Vercel, Netlify, etc.) directly from the admin UI.

- Peer dependencies: `payload` (^3.74.0), `@payloadcms/ui` (^3.74.0), `react` (^18 || ^19), `react-dom` (^18 || ^19)
- Install: `pnpm add @kurto/payload-deploy-trigger`
- Requires the `DEPLOY_HOOK_URL` environment variable. Never commit webhook URLs to your repository.

## Plugin Config (`PayloadDeployTriggerConfig`)

```ts
import { payloadDeployTrigger } from '@kurto/payload-deploy-trigger'

payloadDeployTrigger({
  deployHookUrl: process.env.DEPLOY_HOOK_URL,  // webhook URL (default: process.env.DEPLOY_HOOK_URL)
  cooldownSeconds: 30,                          // cooldown between deployments (default: 30)
  timeoutMs: 10000,                             // webhook request timeout in ms (default: 10000)
  showDashboardWidget: true,                    // show deploy widget on dashboard (default: true)
  showActionButton: true,                       // show "Publish Changes" in admin actions (default: true)
  disabled: false,                              // disable the plugin (default: false)
})
```

## What the Plugin Creates

- **`deployment-history` collection** — audit log of all deployments with user, timestamp, status (success/failed/timeout), duration, error messages. Access restricted to users with `developer` role.
- **`deployment-metadata` global** — tracks last successful deployment timestamp and triggering user. Public read access.
- **`POST /api/deploy` endpoint** — triggers the webhook. Requires authentication.
- **Dashboard widget** — shows last deployment, quick deploy button, history (last 5), cooldown timer.
- **Action button** — "Publish Changes" button in the admin actions menu.

## Webhook Provider Examples

```bash
# Cloudflare Pages
DEPLOY_HOOK_URL=https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/pages/webhooks/deploy_hooks/YOUR_HOOK_ID

# Vercel
DEPLOY_HOOK_URL=https://api.vercel.com/v1/integrations/deploy/YOUR_HOOK_ID

# Netlify
DEPLOY_HOOK_URL=https://api.netlify.com/build_hooks/YOUR_HOOK_ID
```

## Exported Types

```ts
import type { PayloadDeployTriggerConfig, DeploymentStatus } from '@kurto/payload-deploy-trigger'
```
